data.name: Smuggler's Bond
data.description: A transporter must choose his allies as his hunter's bond, not an animal companion. Instead of granting the transporter's favored enemy bonus to his allies as a move action, he instead grants his plot course bonus to his allies constantly. This ability alters hunter's bond.
